name: SOL early-window spread maker
description: Join best bid and ask early in each KXSOL15M window (300-700 mills mid, spread >=2c), hold fills to settlement. Maker, no fee.
hypothesis: Takers at mid prices lose ~3c per print, 1.2c of it gross to the counterparty in the first 5 min; a passive quoter keeps that. Wrong if the engine (which charges trade-through adverse selection) shows <=0 per contract.
next: Rejected ad hoc (-1.84c/ct, 47k ct, Jul 1-7, t -2.28). Revisit with real books once Oct data is development data (Nov 1).
